description: Permission set for artifact widget windows (the deck — PRD Part C / W2). Opaque, frameless, always-on-top panels that render ONE pinned artifact and magnetically dock to the chat. The `widget-*` glob means any other label gets NO IPC at all (fails closed — PRD §23 derisk). These windows deliberately get a NARROWER set than the main window: they may move/resize/drag/close themselves and read the anchor window's geometry for snapping, connect to the same WS server (load-connection), close themselves, and hand off external http(s)/mailto links to the system browser (open-external-url — a markdown artifact's links must not navigate the widget's own webview away from its content) — nothing else.
